name: Gravity placement

updates.board: set_at(state.board, max([r for r in range(params.rows) if state.board[r * params.cols + action.column] == 0]) * params.cols + action.column, state.to_move + 1)

terminal.name: Completed line
terminal.when: (any([all([state.board[(r + k * 0) * params.cols + c + k * 1] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 0 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.cols]) or any([all([state.board[(r + k * 1) * params.cols + c + k * 0] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * 0 < params.cols]) or any([all([state.board[(r + k * 1) * params.cols + c + k * 1] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.cols]) or any([all([state.board[(r + k * 1) * params.cols + c + k * -1] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * -1 < params.cols]))

terminal.name: Full grid draw
terminal.when: all([v != 0 for v in state.board]) and not (any([all([state.board[(r + k * 0) * params.cols + c + k * 1] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 0 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.cols]) or any([all([state.board[(r + k * 1) * params.cols + c + k * 0] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * 0 < params.cols]) or any([all([state.board[(r + k * 1) * params.cols + c + k * 1] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.cols]) or any([all([state.board[(r + k * 1) * params.cols + c + k * -1] == 2 - state.to_move for k in range(params.connect)]) for r in range(params.rows) for c in range(params.cols) if 0 <= r + (params.connect - 1) * 1 < params.rows and 0 <= c + (params.connect - 1) * -1 < params.cols]))
